# AT-Switch v3.14.2

Official open-source release of **AT-Switch** — a local-first provider and model switchboard for AI agents.

AT-Switch 官方开源版本，面向 AI Agent（WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy CN, QClaw, AutoClaw, Codex, 百度搭子 等）的本地优先 Provider 与模型切换工具。

- **Official Website (官网)**: [https://atswitch.io](https://atswitch.io)
- **Documentation (文档)**: [https://atswitch.io/zh/docs](https://atswitch.io/zh/docs)
- **Source Code (开源仓库)**: [https://github.com/atswitch/at-switch](https://github.com/atswitch/at-switch)

---

### New in v3.14.2 / 本次更新

- 新增百度搭子（Baidu DuMate）模型切换，支持 macOS 与 Windows 自动发现。
- 使用账号级 `opencode.jsonc` 保存覆盖配置，支持默认模型、轻量模型及原生别名切换与原始配置恢复。
- 使用前先登录百度搭子并打开一次编码智能体。直连要求 OpenAI Chat Completions；其他协议请使用本地代理。
- 官网下载、更新日志和 Provider 接入文档同步升级。

### Highlights & Key Features (核心特性)

- **Agent Support Matrix (Agent 适配矩阵)**:
  - **Baidu DuMate (百度搭子)**: Native model switching support.
  - **WorkBuddy**: Automated config synchronization with `~/.workbuddy/models.json` & session model handoff.
  - **CodeBuddy CN**: Seamless model switching across global & workspace scopes.
  - **QClaw / AutoClaw**: Electron user data catalog and configuration hot-switching.
  - **Codex**: Non-intrusive configuration switching for `$CODEX_HOME/config.toml`.
- **Protocol Translation & Local Proxy (协议中继与本地代理)**:
  - Dual-mode switching: Direct mode (zero overhead) and Local Proxy mode (on `127.0.0.1`).
  - Seamless bidirectional translation across OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages.
  - Full support for SSE streaming and Tool Calling / Function Calling.
- **Security & Privacy (原生安全与隐私)**:
  - System-native credential storage (macOS Keychain & Windows Credential Manager).
  - Zero plaintext API key storage; zero logging of prompts, completions, or user queries.
  - Transactional config protection with atomic write and automatic rollback.

### Verification Guide (安装与验证指南)

- **Windows 用户**：下载 `AT-Switch_3.14.2_x64-setup.exe` 并运行安装向导。
- **macOS 用户**：
